conviction_note: Most of the quarter's good news (record C$20m FCF and a possible C$50m substantial issuer bid capped at US$1.35) came out on 2026-10-15 and lifted the stock about 8% on 10-16. What is still unpriced leans slightly negative: pre-warned but unquantified non-cash one-time charges from exiting domestic dried flower, a FCF headline flattered by a C$10.6m one-off, and a name whose last four confirmed prints moved -15.1, +1.3, -10.5 and -9.6. Against that, the SIB could formally launch inside the window. So p_up is 45 on a 7% absolute move (-0.7 scaled), and the findings sum to -1.2. The two numbers agree in sign and size.
bar: Revenue bar is about C$232-239m for Q3 2026, and it is not cleanly sourced. FY2026 consensus is CA$909.3m from two analysts (Simply Wall St, 2026-07-31, https://www.webull.com/news/15322104619557888). Less H1 actual of C$431.7m, that implies about C$239m a quarter in H2. A search-snippet USD revenue estimate of about US$165.95m (about C$232m) and an EPS estimate of -US$0.01 had no traceable primary source. Q3 2025 actual was C$244.2m, and Q2 2026 printed -3.7% YoY. There is no company revenue guide, only 'stronger performance in H2' and positive FCF for FY2026 (Q2 release, https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_news/SNDL-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-and-Operational-Results-2026.pdf). With no two agreeing quarter-level sources, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: No current short interest found: the Nasdaq short-interest API returned 503. The last dated figure seen is MarketBeat for about October 2025: about 1.0% of float, 0.7 days to cover (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/SNDL/short-interest). That is stale, but nothing suggests a crowded short. Options are unusable: the baseline reads unusable_chain, no two-sided ATM quotes, skew null, and put/call OI ratio 0.03 on 2,563 contracts, which is retail call-heavy. Spot is US$1.255. Run-up is 0.0% over 5 days and -9.71% over 20 days. The stock is -44% from its 52-week high and +9% off its low. It rose from US$1.14 (10-15 close) to about US$1.23-1.30 after the 10-15 preliminary-results and SIB release. The SIB cap of US$1.35 sits about 7.6% above spot.

findings.finding: SNDL's 2026-10-15 6-K says it is exiting the unprofitable domestic dried flower category and that 'near-term results may be impacted by one-time, primarily non-cash items'. Q3 IFRS results therefore likely carry an unquantified write-down (inventory and/or impairment) against a consensus EPS of about -US$0.01 that probably does not include it. Cannabis Operations gross margin was already 1.8% in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-04): the EPS loss of -$0.05 against -$0.02 consensus was sold -15.1% close to close (2.19 to 1.86, Yahoo bars). Q2 2026 (Jul 28): an operating loss driven by the Jeeter ramp and Cannabis Ops margin collapse sold -9.6% (1.35 to 1.22).
findings.why_not_priced: The warning was qualitative and buried under the 'record FCF' and SIB headline. The stock rose about 8% the next day rather than falling, and no estimate source shows a widened loss. If it were priced, the consensus loss would have widened after 10-15 and the stock would not have rallied into the print.
findings.independence: Same document as the FCF and SIB findings. Separately, the Q2 call (CFO) said Jeeter production cost headwinds 'are expected to persist over the coming months' (https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/transcript/final-sndl-inc-q2-2026-results.pdf).

findings.finding: The pre-announced 'highest quarterly FCF in SNDL's history' of about C$20m includes about C$10.6m from the initial unwinding of a captive insurance arrangement. Underlying FCF is therefore about C$9.4m, against C$16.7m record FCF in Q3 2025, roughly a 44% YoY decline in the cash line the company markets itself on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 delivered 'record FCF' of C$16.7m and still fell -15.1% on the print day, so this name has not paid for FCF headlines on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The one-off component sits in the body of the 6-K, and wire summaries led with 'record FCF'. The stock's +7.9% on 10-16 is the reaction to the headline. Once the full MD&A walk and the call make the quality visible, part of that may unwind. Q3 2025 comparison: https://sndl.com/news/news-details/2025/SNDL-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-and-Operational-Results/default.aspx
findings.independence: Same document as the one-time charge finding. Q3 2025 FCF of C$16.7m is from the company's Q3 2025 release (sndl.com). The company already guided 'positive FCF for the full year', and YTD is +C$5.7m including Q3, so this lands inside guidance.

findings.finding: The board has directed management to pursue a substantial issuer bid of up to C$50m at no more than C$1.92 (US$1.35) a share, to launch only after the Q3 report. At the cap that is about 26m shares, or 10.7% of 243.8m outstanding. Spot is US$1.255, about 7.6% below the cap, so launch terms (price range, timing) announced with the release or on the 10:00 ET call would set a floor/target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The possible-SIB announcement (2026-10-15 after the close, with the preliminary FCF) took the stock from 1.14 to 1.23 (+7.9%) on 10-16, per Yahoo bars. The buyback acceleration in the Q2 release (11.7m shares) did not stop a -9.6% print-day move.
findings.why_not_priced: The bid is 'possible', needs exchange and cross-border approvals, and has no range yet. The stock trades about 7% below the cap, consistent with a market that discounts both whether it launches and where a Dutch-auction range would clear. A firm launch with a range near the cap would close part of that gap. Launch could also slip past 10-28, which is why this is sized below the 10-16 reaction.
findings.independence: Same company document. The 12-month buyback record (21.8m shares for C$43.4m) and the Q2 call statement that the equity 'is trading well below its intrinsic value' (https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_earnings/2026/q2/transcript/final-sndl-inc-q2-2026-results.pdf) corroborate intent.

findings.finding: Liquor Retail, 57% of Q2 revenue (C$134.7m), had same-store sales of -6.2% in Q2 and promotional margin pressure. The industry backdrop stays weak: IBISWorld (Aug 2026) has Canadian beer/wine/liquor stores sinking at a 1.5% CAGR, with provincial liberalisation fragmenting traffic. A Q3 liquor decline of similar size against a strong Q3 2025 summer comp keeps consolidated revenue at or below the about C$235m bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue declines of -3.7% (Q2 2026) and -4.4% (Q1 2026) both printed with sell-offs of -9.6% and -10.5% (Apr 29: 1.47 to 1.315).
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced: the two-analyst consensus already implies about -2 to -5% YoY revenue. Only a worse-than-Q2 liquor comp would be news. Sized small because it is a proxy plus trend extrapolation, with no Alberta liquor sales series found for Jul-Sep 2026.
findings.independence: Proxy: https://www.ibisworld.com/canada/market-research-reports/beer-wine-liquor-stores-industry/ (industry forecast, not company data). Net of the rest of the company: cannabis retail (about 35%) may be improving, see the High Tide finding, which offsets.

findings.finding: Canadian cannabis retail turned positive in summer 2026. High Tide, Canada's largest chain (232 stores), reported on 2026-09-14 that same-store sales were flat for May-July and positive YoY in both June and July. National June 2026 cannabis sales were a reported record C$517.8m. This points to SNDL Cannabis Retail (C$83.2m in Q2, SSS -4.6%) improving in Q3, consistent with management's H2 retail-improvement commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cannabis Retail margin expansion in Q2 (+50bp to 26.4%) did not stop the -9.6% sell-off. The segment is not what this stock has traded on.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer print that landed after SNDL last reported (Jul 28). The two-analyst FY consensus was cut after Q2 (CA$922.0m to CA$909.3m) and has not visibly been revisited. But it is a peer read-through, and SNDL's Alberta/Ontario mix was the weak part of the market in Q2.
findings.independence: Different source pointing the same way: the national June 2026 record of C$517.8m (secondary report of StatCan data, cited via search, not opened). Contra: Stratcann reported Alberta May 2026 -4% YoY (https://stratcann.com/news/canadian-cannabis-sales-reach-485-million-in-may-2026/).

findings.finding: Q2 call: Jeeter production ramp inefficiencies at Kelowna 'are expected to persist over the coming months', and the CEO called Kelowna an 'acute issue'. Cannabis Operations adjusted operating loss was C$9.0m in Q2 against C$2.8m a year earlier, so Q3 Cannabis Ops profitability likely stays deeply negative even before the dried-flower exit charges.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This line drove the Q2 gross profit miss (-C$8.7m YoY in Cannabis Ops) and the -9.6% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, because management told the market to expect it, so it lands inside guidance and is sized near zero. The residual is whether the >C$20m profit-initiative uplift 'mostly over the remainder of the year' visibly shows up in Q3 adjusted operating income. If the initiatives fail to offset, the reported operating line misses the 'stronger H2' framing.
findings.independence: The 2026-10-15 6-K (exit of domestic dried flower) shows management acting on the segment, the same underlying problem. Shares a segment with the one-time charge finding but is an operating, not one-time, line.

findings.finding: Ontario: SNDL reached an agreement in principle with the AGCO, subject to a C$200K fine, under which associated Ontario retail revenue will be deconsolidated while net economics are preserved. Reported revenue will fall mechanically from the effective date, and the call may quantify it.
findings.why_not_priced: The revenue amount was not disclosed. A sell-side model update that cut revenue would show it, and none was found. Economics are preserved, so it is only optics, hence sized small.
findings.independence: None; same document as three other findings.

findings.finding: Cash fell about C$50.7m in Q3, with a C$60.8m SunStream outflow. The 2026-10-15 6-K says SNDL's indirect interest in Parallel (FL/TX/MA medical cannabis, about US$150m annualised revenue, 56 stores) rose from about 67% to about 92% via a rights offering, and SunStream is funding a Gainesville FL cultivation facility. Unrestricted cash falls to roughly C$130m before a C$50m SIB. The money buys a near-controlling US platform still equity-accounted pending Nasdaq/legal clearance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Parallel asset-acquisition close announcement on 2026-07-27 was bought +8.4% (1.245 to 1.35), then fully given back on the Q2 print the next day (-9.6%).
findings.why_not_priced: Consolidation timing and Parallel's operating numbers have never been disclosed. A call update on direct control (which would add about US$150m of revenue toward the C$1bn+ target) is a possible positive, and a cash-drain framing is a possible negative. The financing question was answered: the money buys a ramping US asset, so it is signed slightly positive.
findings.independence: Q2 release and call describe Parallel as 'transformational', with direct control expected 'in the coming months' (https://s201.q4cdn.com/372870431/files/doc_news/SNDL-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-and-Operational-Results-2026.pdf). No independent update on Nasdaq approval was found.

findings.finding: Director Carlo Cannell (of Cannell Capital, an activist-style holder) resigned from SNDL's board 'effective immediately' on 2026-10-06, nine days before the AGM, with no reason given. The stock moved -1.6% that day per the baseline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: -1.6% on the day of the 6-K (baseline history row 2026-10-06).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was public three weeks ago and the SIB came after it. It only matters if the call surfaces a governance disagreement.

findings.finding: The special resolution to consolidate (reverse-split) common shares received only 54.1% support against the two-thirds required, so SNDL will not proceed. Retail holders rejected management on a capital-structure item, and the share count stays about 243.8m at a sub-US$1.50 price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Released with the SIB and FCF on 10-15; the combined reaction was +7.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Already public and fully priced. It has no bearing on the Q3 numbers. Filed for completeness.

outside_window.finding: The DEA ALJ recommended decision on broader marijuana rescheduling is pending (hearing ended July 2026, post-hearing briefs filed), with no date set. It would move the whole cannabis tape, but nothing dates it inside 10-27/10-28.

EU-GMP certification for the Atholville NB facility is expected within 90 days of the audit announced 2026-08-04, i.e. by about early November. It could be mentioned on the call, but the formal certificate is undated.

baseline_tension: There is no usable skew or implied move. Call-heavy OI (put/call 0.03) and the +8% post-10-15 bounce show retail positioned long into the SIB. My slight negative lean goes against that tape but with this name's reaction history (3 of the last 4 prints sold about 10%). The SIB cap about 7.6% above spot limits conviction, so p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 / reaction function: the confirmed-print history (3 of 4 sold about 10%) trims the High Tide peer read-through positive from +0.4 to +0.3.

Untrustworthy baseline history: the base rate was already rebuilt from confirmed releases (median abs about 10%) before reading. Lesson 8 (understatement) raises abs_move_pct from 6 to 7, net of pre-released FCF/SIB.
Rule 6 bar: there is no two-source agreeing quarter consensus, so all findings stay capped small (unchanged).

Rule 2: the unquantified reported-quarter non-cash charge is kept on reported_quarter at -1.0 rather than shrunk as a pure one-off, because the file says unquantified reported-quarter impairments have paid.
Rule 4 financing: the SunStream/Parallel outflow was checked for what it buys (92% of a US$150m-revenue US platform), and the slight positive is left standing.
Rule 7: short interest was looked up (stale, about 1% of float, not crowded), so the negatives were not shrunk.
